scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, value proposition, and CTAs correctly

steps.description: Open the MirDB homepage in a web browser
steps.context: User arrives at the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that product logo, name, tagline, and description are visible
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Confirm 'Get Started' primary CTA and 'View Documentation' secondary CTA are present and clickable
steps.context: CTAs should be prominent and accessible

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is displayed prominently
Tagline contains 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol'

test_cases.input: Locate and verify primary CTA button
test_cases.expected: 'Get Started' button is visible and has correct styling

test_cases.input: Locate and verify secondary CTA button
test_cases.expected: 'View Documentation' button is visible and links to documentation
Logo image is rendered with appropriate alt text

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section displays three key feature cards with correct content about Memcached compatibility, persistence, and LSM architecture

steps.description: Scroll to or navigate directly to the features section
steps.context: Features section should be below the hero section

steps.description: Check that all three feature cards are present with correct content
steps.context: Each card should highlight a key differentiator

steps.description: Confirm each feature has a title and descriptive text
steps.context: Content should be clear and informative

test_cases.expected: Features section exists with heading and three feature cards
Card displays Memcached compatibility feature with description about existing clients and tools
Card displays persistence feature with description about data surviving restarts and SSTable format
Card displays LSM tree architecture feature with description about skip list memtables
Three feature cards are displayed in a grid or row layout

scenarios.name: Quick Start Section
scenarios.description: Verify the getting started section displays installation commands and basic usage examples that users can copy

steps.description: Scroll to or navigate directly to the getting started section
steps.context: Section should provide actionable steps for new users

steps.description: Check that cargo installation command is displayed
steps.context: Command should be in a code block for easy copying

steps.description: Confirm basic configuration and usage examples are provided
steps.context: Examples should demonstrate common operations

test_cases.input: Locate quick start section on page
test_cases.expected: Quick Start or Getting Started section exists with clear heading
Cargo installation command is displayed in a code block
Basic configuration example is provided showing how to configure MirDB
Example showing telnet or client usage with SET/GET commands is displayed
Code blocks have copy functionality or are selectable for copying

scenarios.name: Commands Reference Section
scenarios.description: Verify the commands section displays supported Memcached operations with descriptions

steps.description: Scroll to or navigate directly to the commands reference section
steps.context: Section should list supported operations

steps.description: Check that all supported commands are listed (SET, GET, DELETE, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND)
steps.context: Each command should have a brief description

test_cases.expected: Commands section exists with list or table of supported operations
SET command is listed with description of its functionality
GET command is listed with description of its functionality
DELETE command is listed with description of its functionality

test_cases.input: Verify additional commands (ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND)
test_cases.expected: All additional commands are listed with descriptions

scenarios.name: Architecture Overview Section
scenarios.description: Verify the architecture section displays data flow diagram and component explanations (WAL, Memtable, SSTable)

steps.description: Scroll to or navigate directly to the architecture overview section
steps.context: Section should explain the technical architecture

steps.description: Check that a visual diagram showing data flow is present
steps.context: Diagram should show WAL -> Memtable -> SSTable flow

steps.description: Confirm explanations for WAL, Memtable, and SSTable are provided
steps.context: Each component should be briefly explained

test_cases.expected: Architecture section exists with heading and content
Visual diagram or illustration showing data flow is displayed
Architecture diagram has appropriate alt text for accessibility
Write-Ahead Log (WAL) is mentioned and explained for durability
Memtable (in-memory) and SSTable (on-disk) components are explained

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards including proper heading hierarchy, alt text, and keyboard navigation

steps.description: Verify proper use of h1, h2, h3 tags in logical order
steps.context: Only one h1, followed by h2, h3 in proper hierarchy

steps.description: Verify all images have appropriate alt text
steps.context: Decorative images may have empty alt, informative images need descriptive alt

steps.description: Navigate entire page using only keyboard (Tab, Enter, Arrow keys)
steps.context: All interactive elements should be focusable and operable

steps.description: Verify text has sufficient contrast against backgrounds
steps.context: WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text

test_cases.expected: Page has exactly one h1 element containing product name
Headings follow logical order without skipping levels (h1 -> h2 -> h3)

test_cases.input: Check all images for alt attributes
test_cases.expected: All img elements have alt attributes with appropriate text
All interactive elements are reachable via Tab key with visible focus indicators
No critical accessibility violations detected
All text meets minimum contrast requirements (4.5:1 for normal, 3:1 for large)

steps.description: Load the page and measure time to fully interactive

test_cases.expected: Page loads within 3 seconds on standard connection

Images are compressed and appropriately sized

Below-fold images use lazy loading
